after.selection_gpr_restore_evidence: LIP2 encodes the secreted extracellular lipase: a lip2 knockout has no detectable extracellular lipase activity and forms no halo on triolein plates (Pignede et al. 2000, J. Bacteriol. 182:2802). The knockout still grows on triglycerides, so LIP2 is not the only route for triglyceride use. NCBI Gene 2905927 (YALI1_A21372g) cross-references UniProt Q9P8F7 (lip2). The restored equation adds the 3 H2O of hydrolysis.

after.selection_gpr_restore_evidence: URA3 encodes orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase: in PO1f the URA3 deletion leads to orotic-acid accumulation and secretion, attributed to the missing orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase, and a URA3 rescue mutant completely prevents the secretion (Swietalski et al. 2022, Yeast 39:230, abstract only). NCBI Gene 90949730 (YALI1_E31685g) cross-references Swiss-Prot Q12724 PYRF_YARLI (URA3, EC 4.1.1.23); the model's UniProt A0A1H6PUU4, now deleted from UniProtKB, is the same sequence (UniParc UPI0000132D4C). PO1f ura3-302 stays represented by the runtime strain overlay.
